from itertools import permutations

topics = ["lith", "oil", "sculp", "water"]
hist = ["F", "G", "H", "J"]

solutions = []
for tp in permutations(range(1, 5)):
    t = dict(zip(topics, tp))  # topic -> position
    for ht in permutations(topics):
        topic_of = dict(zip(hist, ht))
        p = {h: t[topic_of[h]] for h in hist}  # historian -> position
        if not (t["oil"] < t["lith"] and t["water"] < t["lith"]):
            continue
        if not (p["F"] < t["oil"]):
            continue
        if not (p["H"] < p["G"] and p["H"] < p["J"]):
            continue
        solutions.append((t, p))

opts = {
    "A": lambda t, p: p["F"] < t["sculp"],
    "B": lambda t, p: p["H"] < t["lith"],
    "C": lambda t, p: t["sculp"] < p["G"],
    "D": lambda t, p: t["sculp"] < p["J"],
    "E": lambda t, p: t["water"] < p["G"],
}

print("valid schedules:", len(solutions))
must = []
for k, f in opts.items():
    bad = [s for s in solutions if not f(*s)]
    ok = len(bad) == 0
    print(k, "must be true" if ok else "counterexample: topics=%s hist=%s" % bad[0])
    if ok:
        must.append(k)

print("must-be-true options:", must)
claimed = "D"
if solutions and must == [claimed]:
    print("CHECK PASS")
else:
    print("CHECK FAIL")
